examples: She felt hurt when her old friend decided to snub her at the reunion.
او احساس آسیب کرد وقتی دوست قدیمی‌اش تصمیم گرفت در گردهمایی به او بی‌اعتنایی کند.
The committee chose to snub the controversial author by excluding his book from the award list.
کمیته با حذف کتاب آن نویسنده بحث‌برانگیز از فهرست جایزه، او را تحویل نگرفت.
He tried to shake her hand, but she snubbed him and walked straight past.
او سعی کرد با او دست بدهد، اما او بی‌اعتنایی کرد و مستقیم از کنارش رد شد.
miniContext: To snub someone means to deliberately ignore or treat them with disrespect, often to show disapproval. Celebrities are sometimes accused of snubbing fans who wait for hours just to get an autograph. After being snubbed at the meeting, he decided never to offer his help again.

examples: The villagers feared the king's wrath if they failed to pay their taxes on time.
روستاییان از خشم شدید پادشاه می‌ترسیدند اگر مالیاتشان را به‌موقع پرداخت نمی‌کردند.
Her wrath was so intense that no one dared to speak during the meeting.
خشم شدید او آن‌قدر زیاد بود که هیچ‌کس در طول جلسه جرئت صحبت کردن نداشت.
The novel describes a storm so violent that sailors called it the wrath of the sea.
این رمان طوفانی را توصیف می‌کند که آن‌قدر خشن بود که ملوانان آن را خشم دریا می‌نامیدند.
miniContext: Wrath is a strong, often overwhelming feeling of anger, frequently associated with punishment or revenge. In ancient myths, gods were often portrayed as unleashing their wrath on mortals who disobeyed them. He braced himself for his mother's wrath after admitting he had wrecked the family car.

examples: She sat by the window for an hour to ponder her next career move.
او یک ساعت کنار پنجره نشست تا با دقت درباره قدم بعدی شغلی‌اش فکر کند.
Before answering, he paused to ponder the consequences of each choice.
قبل از پاسخ دادن، او مکث کرد تا با دقت درباره پیامدهای هر انتخاب فکر کند.
Philosophers have long pondered the question of what makes a life truly meaningful.
فیلسوفان مدت‌هاست با دقت به این پرسش فکر کرده‌اند که چه چیزی زندگی را واقعاً معنادار می‌کند.
miniContext: To ponder means to think about something carefully and for a long time before reaching a conclusion. Travelers often ponder which route to take when faced with several equally scenic options. After the diagnosis, the family spent sleepless nights pondering what treatment would be best.

examples: Athletes must maintain a strict training schedule to stay competitive.
ورزشکاران باید یک برنامه تمرینی سخت را حفظ کنند تا رقابتی باقی بمانند.
The company has to maintain its equipment regularly to avoid costly breakdowns.
شرکت باید تجهیزاتش را به‌طور منظم حفظ و نگهداری کند تا از خرابی‌های پرهزینه جلوگیری کند.
Despite the evidence against him, he continued to maintain that he was innocent.
با وجود شواهد علیه او، او همچنان اظهار می‌داشت که بی‌گناه است.
miniContext: To maintain something means to keep it in good condition, or to keep insisting that something is true. Gardeners work hard all season to maintain the colorful flower beds in the park. Even after losing the case, the lawyer continued to maintain that his client had been treated unfairly.

examples: Soldiers had to endure freezing temperatures during the long winter campaign.
سربازان مجبور بودند دماهای یخ‌زننده را در طول کارزار طولانی زمستانی تحمل کنند.
Many small businesses did not endure the economic downturn and were forced to close.
بسیاری از کسب‌وکارهای کوچک رکود اقتصادی را تحمل نکردند و مجبور به تعطیلی شدند.
She endured years of difficult training before finally qualifying for the national team.
او سال‌ها تمرین سخت را تحمل کرد پیش از آنکه سرانجام برای تیم ملی واجد شرایط شود.
miniContext: To endure means to survive through something difficult or painful without giving up. Ancient stone bridges in the region have managed to endure centuries of floods and earthquakes. Despite the pain, the marathon runner endured the final miles and crossed the finish line.

meaning: در معرض قرار دادن؛ آشکار کردن
examples: The investigation managed to expose years of corruption inside the city council.
این بازجویی توانست سال‌ها فساد درون شورای شهر را آشکار کند.
Parents should not expose young children to violent movies or video games.
والدین نباید کودکان خرد را در معرض فیلم‌ها یا بازی‌های ویدیویی خشن قرار دهند.
The documentary aims to expose how factories pollute nearby rivers without consequences.
این مستند قصد دارد آشکار کند چگونه کارخانه‌ها بدون پیامدی رودخانه‌های اطراف را آلوده می‌کنند.
miniContext: To expose means to reveal something hidden, or to allow someone to be affected by something, often risky. Journalists risk their careers, and sometimes their safety, to expose wrongdoing by powerful people. Spending too much time in the sun can expose your skin to harmful radiation.

examples: According to local legend, a dragon once lived in the caves beneath the mountain.
طبق افسانه محلی، زمانی یک اژدها در غارهای زیر کوه زندگی می‌کرد.
The old sailor is something of a legend in this fishing village.
آن ملوان پیر در این روستای ماهیگیری تا حدی یک افسانه است.
Historians have tried to separate historical fact from legend in the story of the ancient king.
تاریخ‌دانان سعی کرده‌اند حقیقت تاریخی را از افسانه در داستان آن پادشاه باستانی جدا کنند.
miniContext: A legend is a traditional story, often based loosely on real events, that has been passed down for generations. Every culture seems to have its own legend explaining how a famous landmark came to exist. Long after his retirement, fans still speak of him as a legend of the sport.

examples: Each voter received a ballot listing all the candidates running for mayor.
هر رأی‌دهنده یک برگه رأی دریافت کرد که تمام نامزدهای شهرداری را فهرست می‌کرد.
Election officials carefully counted every ballot before announcing the results.
مقامات انتخاباتی قبل از اعلام نتایج، هر برگه رأی را با دقت شمردند.
Voters were asked to mark their choice clearly on the ballot and fold it before submitting.
از رأی‌دهندگان خواسته شد انتخابشان را به‌وضوح روی برگه رأی علامت بزنند و قبل از تسلیم آن را تا کنند.
miniContext: A ballot is the paper or card used by voters to make an official choice in an election. In some countries, citizens can request a mail-in ballot if they cannot visit a polling station in person. A damaged or unclear ballot can sometimes be rejected during the final vote count.

examples: Fishermen unloaded their catch onto the wharf early in the morning.
ماهیگیران صبح زود صیدشان را روی اسکله تخلیه کردند.
Tourists walked along the old wharf, watching boats come and go.
گردشگران در طول اسکله قدیمی قدم می‌زدند و قایق‌هایی را که می‌آمدند و می‌رفتند تماشا می‌کردند.
The cargo ship docked at the wharf to unload hundreds of containers.
کشتی باربری در اسکله پهلو گرفت تا صدها کانتینر تخلیه کند.
miniContext: A wharf is a structure built along a shore where ships can load and unload goods or passengers. The old wooden wharf has been repaired several times after decades of storms. Restaurants near the wharf serve fresh seafood brought in directly from the boats each morning.

examples: The minister decided to resign after the scandal became public.
وزیر بعد از آنکه رسوایی علنی شد، تصمیم گرفت استعفا دهد.
She plans to resign from her position at the end of the month.
او قصد دارد تا پایان ماه از سمتش استعفا دهد.
After months of conflict with management, he finally resigned rather than compromise his values.
بعد از ماه‌ها درگیری با مدیریت، او سرانجام ترجیح داد استعفا دهد تا اینکه ارزش‌هایش را زیر پا بگذارد.
miniContext: To resign means to formally give up a job or position, usually by submitting a written notice. Company shareholders were shocked when the chief executive chose to resign without warning. Faced with mounting pressure, the coach decided to resign rather than face another losing season.

examples: Lawmakers voted to amend the outdated law to better protect tenants.
قانون‌گذاران رأی دادند قانون قدیمی را اصلاح کنند تا از مستأجران بهتر محافظت شود.
The committee will amend the contract to include the new payment terms.
کمیته قرارداد را اصلاح خواهد کرد تا شرایط پرداخت جدید را شامل شود.
Students were asked to amend their essays after receiving feedback from the teacher.
از دانش‌آموزان خواسته شد بعد از دریافت بازخورد از معلم، مقالاتشان را اصلاح کنند.
miniContext: To amend something means to make small changes to it in order to improve or correct it. The constitution has been amended several times since it was first written. After the error was discovered, the company quickly amended its public statement to reflect the correct figures.

examples: The company took drastic measures to cut costs, including closing two factories.
شرکت اقدامات شدید و اساسی برای کاهش هزینه‌ها انجام داد، از جمله تعطیل کردن دو کارخانه.
Doctors recommended a drastic change in diet to control his rising blood pressure.
پزشکان یک تغییر شدید و اساسی در رژیم غذایی را برای کنترل فشار خون رو به افزایش او توصیه کردند.
There was no need for such a drastic reaction over a simple misunderstanding.
نیازی به چنین واکنش شدید و اساسی برای یک سوء‌تفاهم ساده نبود.
miniContext: Drastic describes an action or change that is extreme and often sudden, usually taken in response to a serious problem. The city took drastic steps to reduce water usage during the worst drought in decades. Rather than make drastic cuts to staff, the manager chose to reduce everyone's hours slightly instead.
